title: Retrieve BPVB crystal structure
action: Download the CIF file of BPVB from the Cambridge Crystallographic Data Centre using deposition number CCDC 628422.
description: Obtain the crystal structure required for periodic and dimer calculations.

title: Compute monomer properties and reorganization energies
action: Optimize the geometry of the BPVB monomer in neutral, cationic, and anionic states at the B3LYP/6-311++G(d,p) level in CHCl₃ solvent. From the total energies compute adiabatic and vertical ionization potentials, electron affinities, HOMO/LUMO energies, and hole/electron reorganization energies.
description: Intermediate step that provides reorganization energies required for Marcus hopping rates.

title: Compute electronic band gap
action: Using the experimental BPVB unit cell from the CIF, perform a periodic DFT calculation with the GGA-PBE functional on the reported k-point mesh. Extract the band gap Eg as the energy difference between the valence band maximum and conduction band minimum.
description: Headline band gap of the crystal. The checker compares the reported Eg to the hidden paper value.

title: Compute effective transfer integrals
action: Extract the nearest-neighbor dimers (P, T1, T2 channels) from the BPVB crystal packing. For each dimer, perform a single-point DFT calculation to obtain the Kohn-Sham Hamiltonian and monomer HOMO/LUMO orbitals. Compute the effective hole and electron transfer integrals V_eff^h and V_eff^e using the fragment orbital approach. Report the values in meV.
description: Channel-resolved effective couplings. The checker compares each reported (V_eff_h, V_eff_e) to the paper values.

title: Compute anisotropic charge mobilities
action: Combine the effective couplings, reorganization energies, intermolecular distances and angles from the crystal packing, and apply Marcus theory and the anisotropic mobility orientation function to compute the maximum hole mobility μ_h_max and maximum electron mobility μ_e_max.
description: Target transport property; load-bearing because it cannot be computed without the reorganization energies and effective couplings from the process and scored steps.
